explicitOverrides.sourceRewriteReason: Benchmark isolation only: prevents automatic source edits from changing the frozen cases. The packaged auto default is verified separately.

baseline.source: Phase 20 adaptive measurement, 128 tests, workers=1, scoreCap=0.6
baseline.rule: Exact per-case outcomes are frozen below. Any difference must be disclosed and classified; no product or benchmark code may be changed after measurement without a new preregistration.

acceptance.note: The historical rc.8 baseline is not reproduced. Differences are disclosed below; no product or benchmark code was changed after this measurement.

if04Diagnostic.reason: The only baseline pass -> final failure was rerun separately to test reproducibility.
if04Diagnostic.failure: Timeout 2000ms on nested frame click; outer frame healed, inner frame refused with adaptive-no-evidence (signals [], context 0).
